notices.title: NCSU Locum Physician Services Sole Source Notice
notices.agency_path: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE.BILLINGS AREA INDIAN HEALTH SVC
notices.description_text:
NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE-SOURCE ACQUISITION

Description:

This is a notice of intent to award a sole-source contract and is not a request for competitive quotes.

The Billings Area Indian Health Service intends to award a sole-source purchase order to Watanabe Enterprises for Locum Physician Services for the period of performance December 1, 2026 through January 30, 2027. The Government intends to use the procedures at 12.102(b), 12.201-1, and 6.103-1, subject to the approved acquisition strategy and determination that only one source is reasonably available. The sole-source action is necessary to ensure continuity of critical medical provider services at the Northern Cheyenne Service Unit while the Government completes the competitive acquisition and award of the follow-on requirement. Watanabe Enterprises currently has qualified and credentialed medical providers available to continue providing the required services during this limited interim period, thereby preventing a lapse in essential patient-care services. See attached Performance Work Statement for details.

This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals or quotations. Any party who believes it can perform this requirement should submit a capability statement for consideration by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.

The Government will not be responsible for any costs incurred by responding to this notice. Interested parties may identify their interest and submit a capability statement no later than September 15th, 2026 at 2pm Mountain Standard Time. Responses, including questions about this notice, shall be sent via email to Contract Specialist Johnna Spotted at Johnna.Spotted@ihs.gov.

notices.title: Nurse Practitioner - Ute Mountain Ute Health Center - Towaoc, CO
notices.agency_path: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE.ALBUQUERQUE AREA INDIAN HEALTH SVC
notices.description_text:
SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE

This Sources Sought Notice is being posted for market research and acquisition planning purposes only. The purpose of this notice is to identify qualified businesses capable of satisfying the requirement described below and to assist the Government in determining whether the requirement can be fulfilled through a Buy Indian Act set-aside for Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs) or Indian Economic Enterprises (IEEs), or, if a Buy Indian Act set-aside is not practicable, through a Total Small Business Set-Aside.

This notice is not a solicitation, Request for Quotation (RFQ), or Request for Proposal (RFP), and responses to this notice are not offers. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparing or submitting information in response to this notice.

Pursuant to 48 CFR Part 326, Subpart 326.603-3 and IHM 5-5.6, the Indian Health Service must use the negotiation authority of the Buy Indian Act, 25 U.S.C. 47, to give preference to Indian Economic Enterprises (IEEs) when authorized and practicable.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

The Albuquerque Area Indian Health Service is conducting market research pursuant to FAR 10.001 to identify businesses capable of providing the services described below.

1. NAICS Code: 621399 – Offices of All Other Miscellaneous Health Practitioners

a. If a different NAICS code is suggested, please provide the proposed NAICS code and rationale.

2. Description of Requirement:

The Indian Health Service (IHS), Albuquerque Area Office, Ute Mountain Ute Service Unit (UMUSU), is conducting market research to identify qualified vendors capable of providing one (1) full-time Nurse Practitioner to provide non-personal healthcare services at the Ute Mountain Ute Service Unit located in Towaoc, Colorado.

Services will include comprehensive outpatient primary care for pediatric, adult, and geriatric patients, including assessment, evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, medication management, preventive care, referrals, and coordination of care. The Nurse Practitioner will support scheduled clinics, same-day appointments, and walk-in patient care.

The Nurse Practitioner will be required to possess the applicable professional licensure, certification, clinical experience, and credentials necessary to independently provide the required services.

Services are anticipated at up to 2,000 hours per year, generally Monday through Friday during regular clinic hours. The anticipated period of performance is one base year with four one-year option periods.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Responses to this notice should include the following:

1.) Company Information and SAM Registration

Company name and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI). Respondents should have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://www.sam.gov. The Government will use the UEI provided to verify the respondent's SAM registration status. If the respondent's SAM registration is not currently active, the response should identify the status of its registration.

2.) Business Size and Socioeconomic Status

Identify the company's business size and applicable socioeconomic status under NAICS Code 621399, including, as applicable:

 Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE);

 Indian Economic Enterprise (IEE);

 Small Business;

 HUBZone Small Business;

 Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB);

 Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB); and/or

 Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB).

3.) IHS IEE Representation Form

Complete the attached form titled "IHS IEE Representation Form" and indicate whether the company "does" or "does not" meet the definition of an Indian Economic Enterprise (IEE). This information will be used for market research purposes.

4.) Capability Information

Provide a capability statement and any relevant past performance information demonstrating the company's capability to provide the required Nurse Practitioner services. The response should contain sufficient information for the Government to determine the company's capability to perform the requirement described in this notice.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS

Please submit all requested information to Shandiin DeWolfe via email at Shandiin.DeWolfe@ihs.gov no later than Thursday, September 17, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. MDT.

Automated responses and responses that do not provide sufficient information to address the requirements of this Sources Sought Notice may not be considered for purposes of this market research.

notices.description_text:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued.

RFQ Solicitation Number W912K6-26-Q-1CEI and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01, dated 13 March 2026.

Service Description: The Maryland Army National Guard (MDARNG) Surgeon's Office requires contract medical provider services to perform medical readiness examinations, including Periodic Health Assessments (PHA), Post-Deployment Health Assessments (PDHA), and Post-Deployment Health Re-Assessments (PDHRA), to maintain and improve the Individual Medical Readiness (IMR) goals of the Maryland Army National Guard.

The Period of Performance shall be for one (1) full year from the date of award.

Anticipated PoP: 30 September 2026 to 29 September 2027

The contractor shall provide a licensed medical provider between the hours of 0800–1630 on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday, except on recognized US Federal holidays, during administrative closings, or when the Government facility is closed due to local/national emergencies.

Lunch Break: A 30-minute unpaid lunch is scheduled for each duty day.

Holiday Blackout Period: No services shall be performed from 24 December 2026 through 04 January 2027.

Work Locations: Performance shall be divided across two military installations in Maryland. Typically, the schedule will consist of two (2) days at CFMR and one (1) day at Edgewood per week:

 

 Camp Fretterd Military Reservation (CFMR)

 5555 Rue Saint Lo Drive, BLDG 205

 Reisterstown, MD 21136

 The Flight Surgeon's Clinic

 2624 Fairview Point Road, Building E-6814

 Edgewood, MD 21040

INSTRUCTIONS TO ALL OFFERORS 

a. Review the combined Synopsis solicitation PDF attachment for more details.

b. Contractor shall review the Performance Work Statement (PWS) to understand the nature of this requirement and to meet government criteria for award.

c. Questions and Answers deadline will be 02 September 2026 at 08AM EST.

Proposal Submission Instructions – CLIN Structure

Offerors shall submit their price proposal using the following Contract Line Item Number (CLIN) structure. Complete every field. Unit prices must be fully burdened (inclusive of all direct costs, indirect costs, overhead, G&A, profit/fee, and any other applicable charges). No additional line items or alternate formats will be accepted.
